name: Logical set of six Pauter 993-230-580-1270F connecting rods (aftermarket, inventory only)

relationship_sources.claim: Pauter sells part 993-230-580-1270F as a set of six 4340 chrome-moly connecting rods for the Porsche 993 and 993 Turbo; its dimension table lists 6 cylinders.

known_limits: Logical set only: six identical rods, one per cylinder position. The position numbers are a record convention, not the Porsche cylinder numbering; no transform, crankpin or piston-pin interface is positioned.

Inventory only. A connecting rod is a highly loaded internal engine component: no reproduction, modification or manufacture without documented professional engineering review and an approved validation plan (SAFETY.md, AGENTS.md).
No mounting relation is recorded: the crankshaft, the piston pins and the rod bolts have no component record, and the rod bolt size and torque are not sourced.
Aftermarket set: the 3,210 g sum is the mass of this product, not of the original Porsche rods, and must not be added to an engine mass that already includes the rods.
